goal: Try the newer noun-first PRISM temperature example and inspect an averaged pipe in both scientific directions
command: from cubedynamics import data, pipe, verbs as v; import json; cube=data.temperature(source="prism", statistic="maximum", bbox=[-105.55,39.85,-105.05,40.15], start="2024-01-01", end="2024-01-03"); print("CUBE", type(cube).__name__, dict(cube.sizes), cube.name, cube.attrs); analysis=pipe(cube)|v.mean(over="time", keep_dim=False); out=analysis.unwrap(); print("OUT", type(out).__name__, dict(out.sizes), out.name, out.attrs); print("STATE", json.dumps(analysis.semantic_state.as_dict(), indent=2, default=str)); print("TRACE", json.dumps([step.as_dict() for step in analysis.semantic_trace], indent=2, default=str)); print("EXPLAIN", analysis.explain()); print("VALIDATE", analysis.validate())
expected_behavior: The noun loader returns real data and the pipe exposes a sensible mean result, semantic state, ordered trace, explanation, and validation
